name: International protection (ochrona międzynarodowa) -- refugee status and subsidiary protection

qualifying_event.description: Well-founded fear of persecution (refugee status) or a real risk of serious harm such as the death penalty, torture, or serious threat from armed conflict (subsidiary protection) in the country of origin.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Personal testimony plus any corroborating documentation of the persecution or risk; identity documents where available, though their absence does not bar an application.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a well-founded fear of persecution (race, religion, nationality, political opinion, or social group membership) for refugee status, or a real risk of serious harm (death penalty, torture, or serious threat from armed conflict) for subsidiary protection, in the country of origin.
The application must be lodged in Poland or at a Polish border crossing point, typically with the Border Guard (Straż Graniczna).

evidence_required.document: Personal testimony and any supporting documentation of persecution or risk of serious harm
Identity documents where available (their absence does not bar an application)

outcome.duration_length: refugee status and subsidiary protection are granted for an unlimited period, though the residence card is issued for a fixed term and renewed
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: 5 years continuous legal residence in connection with refugee status, subsidiary protection, or humanitarian-grounds stay, counted from the start of the international-protection procedure even if held in a guarded centre during that time

sources.title: gov.pl / Urząd do Spraw Cudzoziemców -- Azyl (Office for Foreigners, official asylum information)
gov.pl / Urząd do Spraw Cudzoziemców -- Ochrona międzynarodowa, corroborating the refugee-status and subsidiary-protection distinction

Moduł Obsługi Spraw (mos.cudzoziemcy.gov.pl) -- confirming that time in a guarded centre or detention during the international-protection procedure counts toward the 5-year continuous-residence calculation

notes: Distinguished here from ochrona czasowa (temporary protection), the separate mass-influx mechanism activated for Ukrainian nationals displaced since 24 February 2022, which is not itself a route to citizenship or permanent residence and is not modeled as a separate route file in this initial build -- flagged as a candidate addition given its scale (the UdSC gov.pl homepage prominently features temporary-protection extension notices through at least March 2028 as of this research pass) but structurally it is an EU Temporary Protection Directive mechanism rather than Poland's ordinary international-protection route, and modeling it correctly would need its own qualifying_event and a status value this schema doesn't yet have a clean slot for (it is neither draft, published, nor closed in the ordinary sense -- it is time-limited by EU Council decision). pr_after_months and citizenship_after_months use the standard 5-year figure confirmed directly against mos.cudzoziemcy.gov.pl's official FAQ on continuous-residence calculation for refugee-status holders specifically -- time spent in a guarded centre or detention during the international-protection procedure counts toward this period, per the same source, a genuinely favourable and non-obvious detail worth surfacing on the route detail page.
